items.title: Walmart (WMT) Launches 40,000 Acre Regenerative Agriculture Effort With General Mills And ADM
items.summary: Walmart (NasdaqGS:WMT), General Mills and ADM are working together on a new regenerative agriculture program. The initiative covers 40,000 Midwest wheat acres with goals tied to soil health, water quality and carbon sequestration. The collaboration is designed as a model for broader industry change across food and retail supply chains.
